Good food, good view, for a true local experience.
Dec 2022 • Friends
When visiting Vietnam, you tends to only stay at the tourists areas that doesn't quite truly represent the city let alone the country, this little home restaurant however does show you what it's like for the locals living in HaNoi.

First to get to the place, you need to travel outside the old quarter, but only about 15' away from the lake, into a tiny alley, then you'll be warmly greeted by the locals that live in the areas, me and my friends booked a floor for ourselves and you get some pretty nice view of the red river and it's resident on the upper floors, the foods are home cooked Vietnamese food with nothing left to be desired.

Overall a nice experience to have for foreigners wanting to know what's loke outside the tourists areas.
